_comment: Who may Edit & Resend or rewind to a user row (shared_crew.edit_rule, website/src/api/editRule.ts). Read by test/test_shared_crew_edit_rule.py, which builds each editor and author from the real identity functions and owner_principal_ids, and by website/src/api/editRule.test.ts. Editors: owner_local, owner_startup and owner_tailnet are the owner under three ids, owner_relay is the owner over the Kiro relay, teammate_relay is a relay teammate, teammate_tailnet a Tailscale collaborator, unknown the Unknown caller, app an app token. Authors: an editor's name stamps that editor; teammate_relay_legacy is a relay teammate's stamp written before the provider was recorded; other_app another app; automation a Crew system component; unknown_stamp a row stamped Unknown (a channel row); absent a row with no author; damaged an author that does not parse.
